name: Jersey pump sub
desc: Jersey club sub in Db major mirroring the 5-kick cell: sine stabs on the tresillo bar, octave pops answering in the stomp bar, sawtooth-pump gain riding the 4-floor grid. Bright-key club bounce rather than dark bass music.

code.full: note("<[db2 ~ ~ db2 ~ ~ db2 ~] [db2 ~ db2 ~ ~ ~ ab1 ~] [db2 ~ ~ db2 ~ ~ db2 ~] [gb1 ~ gb1 ~ ~ ~ ab1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.005).decay(.25).sustain(.28).release(.1).shape(.5).lpf(650).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[db2 ~ db3 db2 ~ db3 db2 ~] [db2 ~ db2 db3 ~ ~ ab1 ab2] [db2 ~ db3 db2 ~ db3 db2 ~] [gb1 gb2 gb1 ~ ab1 ab2 ab1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.004).decay(.22).sustain(.25).release(.08).shape(.55).lpf(800).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
